caption: Figure 1: Diagram of the conversion process used to generate Fashion-MNIST dataset. Two examples from dress and sandals categories are depicted, respectively. Each column represents a step described in section 2.
description:
Figure type: Diagram
Description: The figure is a diagram showing the conversion process used to generate the Fashion-MNIST dataset. It illustrates the steps involved in transforming original images into the dataset format. Two examples, a dress and sandals, are shown through each step.
Text in figure: "1) PNG image", "2) Trimming", "3) Resizing", "4) Sharpening", "5) Extending", "6) Negating", "7) Grayscaling", "51x73", "29x71", "11x28", "28x28", "51x49", "28x27"

caption: Table 2: Class names and example images in Fashion-MNIST dataset.
description:
The figure is a table showing the class names and example images from the Fashion-MNIST dataset. It lists ten categories of clothing items, each with a label and a description. The examples column displays a series of grayscale images representing each clothing type. The categories include T-Shirt/Top, Trouser, Pullover, Dress, Coat, Sandals, Shirt, Sneaker, Bag, and Ankle boots.

Text in figure: Label, Description, Examples. 0, T-Shirt/Top, [images]. 1, Trouser, [images]. 2, Pullover, [images]. 3, Dress, [images]. 4, Coat, [images]. 5, Sandals, [images]. 6, Shirt, [images]. 7, Sneaker, [images]. 8, Bag, [images]. 9, Ankle boots, [images].
